text:
```yaml
name: Regenerate Sonar API Spec Cache
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  regenerate-sonar-api-spec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: "pnpm"
          cache-dependency-path: "**/pnpm-lock.yaml"

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          pnpm --version

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Fetch and regenerate Sonar API spec
        run: |
          node scripts/prepare-embedded-api-spec.js
          npx prettier --write docs/api-specs/sonar-openapi.json

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code || echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "docs: update sonar api spec from upstream"
          title: "docs: update sonar api spec from upstream"
          body: "This PR was automatically generated to update the Sonar API specification from the upstream source.\n\n- Source: https://airbyte-sonar-prod.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/openapi/latest/app.json\n- Updated via: .github/workflows/regenerate-sonar-api-spec.yml"
          branch: "update-sonar-api-spec"
          labels: |
            auto-merge
            autogenerated
            documentation
          delete-branch: true
```
